answer_1.quote: In this study, we focus on building a controllable open-domain AI assistant to follow diverse human instructions.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates responses to user queries in an open-domain dialogue setting, aiming to align with user preferences along multiple dimensions such as helpfulness, harmlessness, and humor.

answer_2.quote: To quantitatively evaluate the quality of the model-generated responses, we employ off-the-shelf reward models in Huggingface Hub to measure the performance on HH-RLHF following Yang et al. (2024b).
